positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Scaled ACH payments background jobs to reduce failures and increase processing volume. Improved payment jobs efficiency, e.g. implemented idempotency checks to eliminate redundant API requests. Added metrics and alerts to improve observability. Triaged job failures. Built metrics dashboards for better on-call visibility. Increased reliability of ACH processing code, finding and eliminating causes of daily interruptions.

• Integrated 3rd party Reconciliation Partner with backend. Collaborated with the 3rd party’s Sales Engineer to trial their reconciliation system. Acted as the technical liaison between 3rd party and senior leadership. Ensured that partner engineers had essential data access. Represented Sardine in cross-company weekly meetings to ensure clear data visibility, that changing payment models were accurately represented in the reconciliation system. Gave feedback to partner to help shape their product.

• Scaled the Payments Team from 2 to 8 Engineers. Worked with the CTO to scale up the payments team. Work included interviewing, documenting, pair programming, pair debugging, training presentations.

• Modernized email templates to be locally testable and extensible. Streamlined email development pipeline. Introduced tooling for devs to build emails on their local machines (otherwise, emails had to be sent to a mail server to be viewed). Collaborated with the design to define styling compatible with most mail clients. Presented to the team on the restrictions of email styling compared to browser styling.

• Introduced static typing to reduce deployment errors and accelerated team development time.
Introduced Sorbet type system to the backend. Iteratively added types to ~95% of payments teams’ 50 domain models. This reduced deployment bugs and errors significantly.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Ported new UI to CircleCI Server 3.0. Spun up a k8s cluster for my team’s development environment. Created and documented a process for releasing. One release was a snapshot of all backend and frontend services that all engineering teams were working on. Prepared handoff documents for UI micro-frontends to transfer ownership to multiple other teams. Paired with receiving team engineers to transfer knowledge.

• Rewrote legacy UI unblocking the organization’s ~200 engineers to make frontend updates. Rewrote legacy Om (React/Clojurescript) UI in Typescript and Next.js (React). Implemented a micro-frontend architecture, establishing clear boundaries of team ownership. Modernized deployments with k8s.

• Helped scale up CircleCI’s first engineering team in the APAC region. Interviewed Senior and Staff Senior Engineer candidates. Onboarded new team members and paired on tasks. Documented tribal knowledge around team processes, systems and deployments.

• Conducted stakeholder interviews and defined the next generation of internal admin tools.
Researched AuthN and AuthZ requirements to define a strategy for the Admin Tools team. Coordinated with the Identities & Permissions team to ensure alignment of tools. Planned for better usability for internal users while providing improved auditability for Ops. This project expanded compliance business opportunities.(e.g. Features required by customers in highly regulated fields such as government & fintech).

• Launched Orbs Registry. Built a package registry for CircleCI. This allowed users to reuse and share their build configurations across projects and companies. Built CLI to build and test orbs locally via API.

positions.title: Support Engineer
positions.description: • Primary Support Engineer for CircleCI 2.0 launch. Performed outreach to beta users and provided white-glove support. Onboarded customers by migrating builds to use new syntax and Docker containers.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Full stack engineer and Extreme Programming process consultant.  Taught client and internal engineers by example: leading team stand-ups, pair programming with each team member, refactoring legacy code, backfilling tests while implementing new features, working closely with product owner to start with simple ideas and iterate.  Filled anchor role (team lead) on 2-8 engineer teams.  Interviewed engineers for Pivotal and clients.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Full stack web engineer in a boutique web consulting startup for Heroku-hosted applications with data storage on Amazon S3.

Technologies:
Ruby on Rails, Sinatra,  RVM

Backbone.js, jQuery, Coffeescript, Javascript, Paper.js

PostgreSQL

Ubuntu, OS X, git

positions.title: Volunteer Tutor
positions.description: Provided academic support to at-risk youth.  Planned and led workshops on anger management for groups of 10-30 teens.

positions.title: Crew Leader
positions.description:
Trained and supervised a crew of approximately 15 enumerators to survey over 1300 households
Acted as liaison between community and management in order to maintain positive public image and address all community member concerns
Scheduled daily meetings with enumerators, assistants and supervisor to discuss problem cases and transfer work for improved productivity
Prepared weekly performance analyses of enumerators to demonstrate completion of objectives to management

positions.title: RF Engineer
positions.description:
Designed antennas using CAD software to meet client performance specs
Performed internal technical support, including network administration
Physically tested antenna prototypes using spectrum and network analyzers
Developed and improved upon internal proprietary software using Matlab that resulted in a design patent for improving the cost of an antenna system
Prepared patent and preliminary patent applications (PPA) resulting in two successful PPAs

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Contributed to n-body problem research on galaxy cluster simulations
Developed optimization of existing code and tested successfully in Matlab Integrated solution into existing C++ code and validated results by measuring and comparing code run times before and after changes
